failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS orders_2018,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS orders_2017,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)
         - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS growth
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mo,
       ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017,
       ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / NULLIF(m17.gmv, 0), 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY m18.mo
LIMIT 12;
